topic: South African parties in coalition talks after ANC's worst election results

en.title: ANC makes DA last resort in municipal coalition talks after election results
en.dek: ANC reportedly turns to DA as final option for municipal coalitions as negotiations continue across South Africa
facts: ANC makes DA last resort in municipal coalition talks according to DailyNews.co.za
Talks ongoing across multiple municipalities including Mangaung according to Bloemfontein Courant
ANC's worst election results drive coalition search
Coalition talks ongoing across multiple municipalities
body: The African National Congress has reportedly made the Democratic Alliance its last resort in municipal coalition talks following the party's worst election results, according to DailyNews.co.za.
Talks are ongoing across multiple municipalities including Mangaung where coalition negotiations loom, according to Bloemfontein Courant.
The ANC's poor election performance has forced the party to explore coalition options it previously resisted, with the DA now positioned as a final option.
Negotiations continue as the ANC seeks to maintain governance in municipalities despite diminished electoral support.
The party's strategy shift reflects the reality of its reduced majority following the election.
Mangaung emerges as a key site for coalition discussions as the ANC navigates its new political landscape.
The Democratic Alliance remains a central figure in the ANC's coalition calculus despite being designated a last resort.
Negotiations across municipalities indicate the scale of the coalition challenge facing the ANC.
The party's approach to coalition-building has fundamentally shifted in response to voter sentiment.
en.context: The ANC, which has governed South Africa since the end of apartheid, has suffered its worst election results to date, forcing the party into coalition negotiations with opposition parties including the DA to maintain municipal governance.

en.headline: ANC makes DA last resort in municipal coalition talks
en.body: ANC reportedly makes DA 'last resort' in municipal coalition talks according to DailyNews.co.za. Talks are ongoing across multiple municipalities including Mangaung where coalition negotiations loom according to Bloemfontein Courant.

de.headline: ANC macht DA letzten Ausweg in kommunalen Koalitionsgesprächen
de.body: Nach Angaben von DailyNews.co.za macht die ANC die DA zum 'letzten Ausweg' in kommunalen Koalitionsgesprächen. Die Gespräche laufen in mehreren Kommunen, darunter Mangaung, wo Koalitionsverhandlungen bevorstehen, wie aus dem Bloemfontein Courant hervorgeht.

es.headline: ANC hace a la DA el último recurso en negociaciones de coaliciones municipales
es.body: El ANC habría hecho de la DA el 'último recurso' en negociaciones de coaliciones municipales según DailyNews.co.za. Las conversaciones continúan en varios municipios, incluido Mangaung, donde se perfilan las negociaciones de coalición según Bloemfontein Courant.

fr.headline: ANC fait de la DA le dernier recours dans les pourparlers de coalition municipale
fr.body: L'ANC ferait de la DA un 'dernier recours' dans les pourparlers de coalition municipale selon DailyNews.co.za. Des pourparlers se poursuivent dans plusieurs municipalités, dont Mangaung, où les négociations de coalition se profilent selon Bloemfontein Courant.

it.headline: ANC rende il DA l'ultima spiaggia nei negoziati di coalizione municipale
it.body: L'ANC avrebbe reso il DA 'ultima spiaggia' nei negoziati di coalizione municipale secondo DailyNews.co.za. I colloqui sono in corso in più comuni, inclusa Mangaung, dove incombono le trattative di coalizione secondo Bloemfontein Courant.

pt.headline: ANC faz da DA último recurso em negociações de coalizão municipal
pt.body: O ANC teria feito da DA o 'último recurso' nas negociações de coalizão municipal, segundo o DailyNews.co.za. As conversações decorrem em vários municípios, incluindo Mangaung, onde as negociações de coalizão se avizinham, segundo o Bloemfontein Courant.

zh.headline: ANC在市政联盟谈判中将DA视为最后选择
zh.body: 据DailyNews.co.za报道，ANC在市政联盟谈判中将DA视为“最后选择”。根据Bloemfontein Courant，包括Mangaung在内的多个市政区域的谈判正在进行中，联盟谈判也迫在眉睫。

ko.headline: ANC, 지방 연정 협상에서 DA를 최후의 수단으로 간주
ko.body: DailyNews.co.za에 따르면 ANC는 지방 연정 협상에서 DA를 '최후의 수단'으로 간주하는 것으로 알려졌다. Bloemfontein Courant에 따르면 만가웅을 포함한 여러 지방에서 협상이 진행 중이며 연정 협상이 임박했다.

ja.headline: ANC、自治体連立協議でDAを「最後の手段」に
ja.body: DailyNews.co.zaによると、ANC（アフリカ民族会議）は自治体連立協議において、DA（民主同盟）を「最後の手段」と位置づけたと報じられた。Bloemfontein Courantによれば、マンガウングを含む複数の自治体で連立交渉が控えており、協議が続いている。
